rationale: Both Shant and Wentao are LA-based engineers working on safety-critical systems—Shant on freight fraud prevention and identity verification at Fenderr Freight, and Wentao on motion planning and trajectory optimization for autonomous vehicles at Woven by Toyota. While their domains differ, they share a technical foundation in building robust, reliable systems and could exchange perspectives on how verification, validation, and algorithmic rigor apply across logistics and robotics.
intro_message: Shant Lokmanian, meet Wentao Wang — you're both LA-based engineers tackling safety and reliability in complex systems (freight verification vs. autonomous vehicle motion planning) and might find useful cross-domain insights.
